description: List production-app reviews with comments created or modified within the last 7 days. Ratings without comments and alpha/beta feedback are excluded. Requires Reply to reviews permission. pageToken pages only within that 7-day window; use Play Console CSV export for older history. An empty result alone does not indicate missing permission.

maxResults.description: Max reviews to return per page (API max is 100)

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response (nextPageToken)

translationLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code to translate review text into

name: google_list_reviews
